senses.gloss:
(ऋ) ग्लेपृ r. 1st cl. (ग्लेपते)
1 To be poor or dependant.
2 To shake, to tremble.
3 To move.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be made weary or exhausted, exhaustible, fatigable^1.
E.
ग्ला or ग्लै to be weary, affix यत्.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

(ऋ) ग्लेवृ r. 1st cl. (ग्लेवते)
To serve, to worship, to gratify by service or devotedness.

(ऋ) ग्लेषृ r. 1st cl. (ग्लेषते)
To inquire, to search, to investigate.
